job.title: Enterprise Account Executive
job.description:
We are partnering with a leading US-based wholesale print and marketing services provider to find a high-performing Enterprise Sales Director (IC)to drive growth across major national accounts.

This is a true hunter opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional who knows how to open doors, build relationships with senior decision-makers and turn opportunities into long-term partnerships.

You will be selling wholesale print and marketing services to major enterprise organizations, engaging primarily with CMOs, Heads of Procurement and other senior stakeholders across industries such as Retail, QSR and Financial Services.

We need someone with a proven track record of winning large, complex accounts, strong prospecting skills and the commercial confidence to take opportunities from initial outreach through to closing.

Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related field preferred
  • 10+ years of progressive B2B business development or complex consultative sales experience, including substantial new-logo enterprise selling.
  • Demonstrated success independently sourcing, winning and launching new customer
  • relationships.Experience navigating executive-level buying groups, enterprise procurement, RFPs, contracting and multi-stakeholder decision processes.
  • Experience winning national brands or multi-location organizations, including QSR, retail or
  • financial services, strongly preferred.Knowledge of commercial, digital and wide-format print, branded marketing materials, fulfillment, distribution and multi-location program delivery strongly preferred.

job.title: Trade Account Executive
job.description:
We are partnering with a leading US-based wholesale print and marketing services provider to find a high-performing Trade Sales Director (IC) to drive growth across its Trade business.This is a true hunter opportunity for a commercially driven sales professional who knows how to open doors, develop strategic relationships and turn opportunities into long-term, high-value partnerships.


You will be selling wholesale print and marketing services to CMOs and Procurement at major business service providers, online print platforms, franchise and distributed networks, as well as national marketing agencies and brokers. You'll be engaging with senior commercial decision-makers, building relationships across complex organizations and identifying opportunities to grow significant national accounts.


We need someone with a proven track record of winning and developing large B2B accounts, strong prospecting skills and the commercial confidence to take opportunities from initial outreach through to closing.
Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related field preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive B2B business development or consultative sales experience, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and strategic account development.

  • Demonstrated success independently sourcing, winning and developing large, complex B2B accounts.

  • Experience selling through business service aggregators, franchise networks, distributed channels, online print platforms, marketing agencies or brokers a must.

  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizations, build relationships with senior decision-makers and develop multi-stakeholder commercial partnerships.

  • Experience managing national accounts and identifying opportunities to expand revenue across multiple locations, business units or distribution channels.

  • Knowledge of commercial, digital and wide-format print, branded marketing materials, fulfillment and distribution strongly preferred.

  • Previous sales training and familiarity with structured sales methodologies a must.
  • Proven hunter mindset and track record of meeting or exceeding new business acquisition and revenue targets.

This position is hybrid in Jersey City or Columbus, OH. Package includes an OTE in the $200-250K region plus competitive benefits.

job.title: Hebrew-speaking Travel Sales
job.description:
Location: Bangkok, Thailand (Office-Based)
Position: Hebrew-Speaking Sales Representative
Employment Type: Full-Time
Languages: Hebrew (Native/Fluent) and English (Good working proficiency)
Compensation: Competitive Salary + High Performance Bonuses
Work Permit: Employer-Sponsored Thai Work Permit
Turn Your Love for Thailand into a Career!

Do you speak Hebrew and have a passion for Thailand? Are you the person your friends and family always turn to for travel recommendations, local tips and advice about the best places to visit?

Have you dreamed of making Thailand more than just a holiday destination?
We are looking for ambitious, motivated and customer-oriented Hebrew-Speaking Sales Representatives to join an international travel and tourism business in Bangkok, Thailand.

This is an exciting opportunity for Hebrew speakers with a background in sales and customer service who want to combine their professional experience with the lifestyle of living in Thailand.

You will work with Hebrew-speaking customers interested in discovering Thailand, helping them find the right travel experiences and services while delivering outstanding customer service and achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
  • Communicate with Hebrew-speaking customers and convert enquiries into sales.
  • Understand customer needs and recommend suitable travel experiences and services in Thailand.
  • Provide excellent customer service throughout the sales process.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Follow up on leads and manage sales opportunities.
  • Work towards individual and team sales targets.
  • Develop in-depth knowledge of Thailand's destinations, attractions and travel experiences.
Requirements
  • Native or fluent Hebrew is essential.
  • Good spoken and written English.
  • Previous experience in sales, business development or customer service.
  • Extensive knowledge of Thailand, its destinations and travel experiences.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A proactive, ambitious and results-driven attitude.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for living and working in Thailand.
  • Minimum age: 24.
Previous experience in travel sales, tourism, hospitality or the travel industry will be a significant advantage.

What We Offer
  • Attractive salary and high performance-based bonuses.
  • Thai employment visa and work permit sponsorship for successful candidates.
  • Full-time position at our Bangkok office.
  • Young, dynamic and international working environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
  • The chance to turn your passion for Thailand into a rewarding career.
